properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued November 17 at 7:23PM EST until November 17 at 9:30PM EST by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northern Broward County in southeastern Florida...

* WHEN...Until 930 PM EST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 723 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Coral Springs, Pompano Beach, Tamarac, Margate, Lauderhill,
Coconut Creek, North Lauderdale, Lauderdale Lakes, Parkland,
Godfrey Road, Broadview-Pompano Park, Village Park, Palm Aire,
Ramblewood East and North Pompano Beach.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Biscayne Bay...

SOURCE...Radar.

hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

Beach, Surfside, North Bay Village, Indian Creek, Miami Beach,
Hollywood, and Fort Lauderdale.

overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.

properties.headline: Flood Watch issued November 17 at 1:32PM AKST until November 19 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream and localized urban flooding caused by rain on
snow is possible.

* WHERE...Including the following area, SW Kenai Peninsula. This
includes the cities of Homer, Anchor Point, Ninilchik, And Clam
Gulch.

* WHEN...From Wednesday morning through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- An atmospheric river event is anticipated to begin Wednesday
morning, with ample moisture transport from the south. With
upslope enhancement, most areas are on track to see 2 to 3 inches
of rainfall from this system, with locally higher amounts with
elevation. Heaviest rainfall rates will occur between Wednesday
afternoon and Thursday morning with about a quarter of an inch
per 3 hour period. This amount of rainfall on the new snowpack
may cause flooding along smaller streams and creeks, in low-lying
and poor drainage areas, and cause ponding of water on roadways.
Rainfall is on track to decrease Thursday.

- Http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 17 at 2:15PM PST until November 19 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 10-19
feet, with local sets of 20-22 feet. Peak surf is expected from
late Wednesday through Thursday night. Dangerous rip currents
expected. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding
expected.

* WHERE...San Luis Obispo County Beaches and Santa Barbara
County Central Coast Beaches.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, until 9 PM PST Friday. For
the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 3 AM to 10 AM PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Moderate flooding of sea water is likely over some
vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the time
of high tide, including over beach parking lots, bike paths, and
harbor walkways. Moderate to significant beach erosion is
likely. Isolated damage is unlikely but possible, especially to
Pismo and Cayucos piers. There is an increased risk for ocean
drowning. Rip currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea.
Large breaking waves can cause injury, wash people off beaches
and rocks, and capsize small boats near shore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...There is a chance for the coastal flood
advisory to be extended through later Thursday to cover the
secondary high tide in the evening.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Do
NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.

Remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions, or stay
near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in
such conditions, stay off the rocks.

sandbar and in the vicinity of structures such as groins, jetties

heavy rainfall will result in the potential for urban and small

rainfall forecast through Friday night is around 3 to 8 inches
with locally higher amounts up to 12 inches or more.

properties.description:
The officials at the Indiana Department of Environmental Management
have declared a Local Air Quality Advisory for Elkhart County, in
effect from 6 PM this evening to 10 AM EST Wednesday.

A Local Air Quality Advisory for PM 2.5 has been issued due to
stagnant conditions and calm winds. Fine particulate levels are
expected to be in the Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups range. Active
children and adults, and people with respiratory disease, such as
asthma should limit prolonged outdoor exposure.

Due to observed and forecasted high concentration of PM2.5 readings
in the area, recommendations are for the public to reduce or avoid
exertion or heavy work outdoors and keep windows and doors closed as
much as possible.

For additional information, please visit the IDEM Smog page at:

http://www.in.gov/idem/airmonitoring/smogwatch/
